changes.text: The chart is one tab stop instead of one per node: a roving `tabindex` keeps the first (then the last-focused) node at `0`, and arrow keys, Home and End move between nodes along each series' line, stage by stage, then on to the next series.
Nodes are `role="img"` marks (were `role="button"` with no action) inside a new `<g class="nodes">` wrapper, carry `data-index`, and use the default cursor instead of a pointer.
The tooltip is `aria-hidden="true"` (was `role="status"`), so a node is no longer announced twice or on hover, and Escape dismisses it, including when it was opened by hover.

Series without a `color` cycle through the shared, exported `CHART_PALETTE`, which reads the palette slots `--ss-accent`, `--ss-blue`, `--ss-magenta`, `--ss-cyan`, `--ss-yellow` and `--ss-green` (was `--ss-primary`, `--ss-blue`, `--ss-purple`, `--ss-cyan`, `--ss-yellow`, `--ss-lime`), so a custom palette recolours every series.

New component: a ranking-over-stages chart that plots each series' finishing rank (1 at the top) across the ordered `stages`, with direct series labels at the line ends (`showLabels`), a hover/focus `tooltip`, and `width`, `height`, `fluid`, `summary` and `size` props.
